Index: /home/agent/workspace/checker.py
===================================================================
--- /home/agent/workspace/checker.py
+++ /home/agent/workspace/checker.py
@@ -194,9 +194,11 @@
 s = re.sub(r'^THEOREM\s+\w+\s*:\s*', '', s)
 s = re.sub(r'^OBL-\d+(\s*\([^)]*\))?:\s*', '', s)
 s = re.sub(r'^\|-\s*', '', s)
 s = re.sub(r'\s*:\s*(Z|List|Prop)\b', '', s)
-s = re.sub(r'defined\([^)]*\)\s*/\\\s*', '', s)
+s, n = re.subn(r'defined\(.*?\)\)\s*/\\\s*', '', s)
+if n:
+    norm.definedness_stripped = True
 s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s).strip()
 q, rest = [], s
 while True:
     m = re.match(r'^forall\s+(\w+)\.\s*', rest)
